labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Audacity

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG AUDACITY_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

# title
ENV TITLE=Audacity \
    NO_GAMEPAD=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/audacity-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y \
    python3-xdg \
    libatk1.0 \
    libatk-bridge2.0 \
    libnss3 \
    libportaudio2 && \
  echo "**** install audacity ****" && \
  if [ -z ${AUDACITY_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    AUDACITY_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/audacity/audacity/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name' | sed 's|^Audacity-||'); \
  fi && \
  cd /tmp && \
  curl -fo \
    /tmp/audacity.app -L \
    "https://github.com/audacity/audacity/releases/download/Audacity-${AUDACITY_VERSION}/audacity-linux-${AUDACITY_VERSION}-x86_64.AppImage" && \
  chmod +x /tmp/audacity.app && \
  ./audacity.app --appimage-extract && \
  mv squashfs-root /opt/audacity && \
  ln -s \
    /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libportaudio.so.2 \
    /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libportaudio.so && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  find /opt/audacity -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001

VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
While we work hard to add new features and bring back missing ones in the upcoming 4.1, this patch release fixes many crashes and project corruption issues.

- #12544 Fixed project corruption when loading projects that contain empty clips.
- #12123 Fixed duplicate .aup4 extensions and errors when replacing projects during Save As.
- #12436 Fixed project corruption when copying between projects.
- #12436 Fixed incorrect pitch and clip loss when moving clips across tracks with different sample rates.
- #12569 Fixed a crash when opening projects with sample snapping enabled.
- #12573 Fixed a crash when selecting Repeat Last Effect after closing a project.
- #12595 Fixed a crash when the Split shortcut is not set.
- #12515 Fixed missing metadata in certain file formats and incorrect title and artist fields.
- #12539 Restored automatic saving during recording.
- #12570 Restored trim, clear selection, and zoom shortcuts. Added PgUp and PgDown timeline scrolling.
- #12292 Fixed NTSC frame snapping.
- #12181 Fixed point labels linking to adjacent labels and guidelines during label stretching
- #12205 Fixed context menu access on collapsed clips.
- #12431 Improved playback latency from input meter display.
- #12151 Improved the status bar layout in narrow windows.
- muse_framework#365 Linux: Fixed File > Import returning no files. (Thanks, @jonata!)
- muse_framework#357 Fixed incorrect handling of CJK characters during text trimming. (Thanks, @xphenomenon!)
